mic.title: Allow the microphone
mic.body: To talk with Pyit Taing Htaung, SafeRoute needs your microphone. Your voice is sent to Google to answer. Nothing is recorded or saved.

overlay.title: Show the shield over other apps
overlay.body: The shield doll floats on top of other apps so you can tap it on anything suspicious. Android opens a settings page where you switch this on.

screen.title: Let SafeRoute see your screen
screen.body: When you tap the doll, SafeRoute reads what is on your screen to check it. It looks only when you tap. Android asks you to confirm.

notifications.title: Allow notifications
notifications.body: Android shows a small notice while the shield runs. The shield works without it, but you may not see that it is on.

guardNotifications.title: Allow notifications
guardNotifications.body: Message Guard warns you with a notice when a message looks risky. Without this permission it cannot show warnings.

contacts.title: Allow contacts
contacts.body: SafeRoute reads a contact only when you pick it, to fill in the name and number.

mic.title: The microphone is off
mic.body: To talk to Pyit Taing Htaung, open Settings, choose Permissions, then Microphone, and allow it. The rest of SafeRoute works without it.

overlay.title: Display over other apps is off
overlay.body: To use the shield, open Settings, find Display over other apps, and allow SafeRoute. The rest of SafeRoute works without it.

screen.title: Screen access was not allowed
screen.body: The shield needs this to see what you want checked. Turn the shield on again and choose Start now. The rest of SafeRoute works without it.

contacts.title: Contacts are off
contacts.body: To pick a contact, open Settings, choose Permissions, then Contacts, and allow it. You can also type the number yourself.
